items.text: On #CesarChavezDay, it's more important than ever we take up his cause of fighting to improve treatment, pay, and working conditions for our farm workers and union brothers and sisters. Cesar Chavez showed us what the power of organizing can accomplish.

This is not the treatment our fallen service members deserve. But as usual, the occupant of the White House is choosing the wealthy over the American people. It's especially disgraceful that he's doing this to Gold Star families.

President Trump's budget is for billionaires. Washington Republicans are on board with enriching corporations and Elon Musk at the expense of health coverage and food assistance for millions of everyday Americans. My statement: https://t.co/ABKCYFvZKL

Washington Republicans continue to target funding for Medicaid, risking healthcare coverage for millions of Americans across the country. And it's all to pay for more tax breaks for billionaires. In #CA31, over 280,000 residents rely on Medicaid, including over 100,000 individuals under the age 19. That's why on #MedicaidDayOfAction my promise to our district is to always stand up against Republican attacks on Medicaid. We need to protect healthcare for everyday Americans.

I’m here at the Capitol to try and stop Trump’s “One Big Billionaire Bailout.”

This bill guts Medicaid coverage, adds trillions to the deficit, and gives tax breaks to the ultra wealthy at the expense of America’s working families. https://t.co/RRuJdqPTaQ

Medicare coverage began on July 1,
1966. Within a year, 19 million Americans aged 65+ were enrolled.

Now 59 years later, Republicans are enacting cuts that will hurt Medicare
recipients and strip healthcare coverage away from millions of Americans.

I’m here in Washington fighting to protect Medicare and Medicaid.

Today, I testified at the Rules Committee to submit an amendment saying what we’re all thinking: nobody wants this Big Ugly Republican Bill.

Millions of people will be kicked off their health insurance and lose their nutrition assistance. This bill is bad for America, our health, and our future.

More than 80% of Planned Parenthood patients in California rely on Medi-Cal programs for healthcare. Trump’s ugly bill just gutted funding for some of their most essential services like cancer screenings, birth control, & STI treatment. This is dangerous and irresponsible.

The GOP forced Trump’s Big Ugly Bill on the American people. We now face the largest cut to Medicaid funding in history. Hospitals in my district alone will lose between $1-2 billion in revenue over the next decade. 

Americans don't want hospital closures or higher wait times. https://t.co/Imf1j5mg4X

This week, I visited Emanate Health in West Covina to tour the hospital and new expansion projects. We discussed their concerns around Medicaid funding cuts and the detrimental impacts of cutting these critical health services. Medicaid is a lifeline for Californians and I will continue to fight to protect affordable, accessible healthcare.

These layoffs will have ripple effects down to the state and local levels. 

Trump has already froze education funds, put Pell Grants in jeopardy, and hurt medical student loans. 

Can we just say it: Trump’s goal is to kill education and make the country stupid.

60 years ago today, President Johnson signed Medicare and Medicaid into law, creating a lifeline for millions of Americans. Now, 17 million Americans are going to lose healthcare coverage in the largest cut to Medicaid in history – all thanks to Trump’s Big Ugly Bill.

https://t.co/FsBBmogJol

The Trump Administration is devastating Los Angeles County’s entire health system and causing pure chaos.
Hospitals and clinics are anticipating mass layoffs, grant funding for combatting the spread of infectious diseases has been slashed, and the county has had to cut its bioterrorism watch program.

https://t.co/wBbS5Xhc33

Today is Honor Our Veterans Day of Action, a reminder of our responsibility to those who’ve sacrificed so much for our country. I am committed to continuing to fight for our veterans every day, whether that’s expanding access to mental health resources, securing critical funding for our servicemembers and their families, or helping our veterans across CA-31 navigate the VA.

On average, we lose 74 people to firearm suicide everyday. Today is #FirearmSuicidePreventionDay to spread awareness and education on the harm of this public health crisis in our country. Gun safety and proper firearm storage is an essential component of suicide prevention.

Vaccines play a vital role in our global health system, keeping our communities safe and protected from so many deadly diseases. With fearmongering and misinformation spreading from our own @HHSGov Secretary Kennedy, it’s more important than ever to stay informed, listen to the science and research, and get vaccinated to protect your friends, families, and loved ones around you.
We can’t trust the science coming out of HHS right now. Listen to the medical experts. https://t.co/RGalZMdGCf

The tax credits that help working families afford healthcare are set to expire while Republican leadership turns a blind eye. Today, I toured the Kaiser Permanente Bernard J. Tyson School of Medicine to speak with staff and see the incredible medical and educational facilities that are at risk of funding cuts that will impact their students, patients, and critical care services around our community.

Democrats are not going to rubber stamp a bill that slashes healthcare and forces families to decide between groceries or medicine. That’s not a “clean CR,” that’s a scam. 

Come back to DC and negotiate.

The cost of living in America is already way too high. Without ACA tax credits next year, hard-working Americans will be forced to choose between feeding their kids and getting their medication. No one should have to make this impossible choice. https://t.co/kktIO5zaeU

In CA-31 alone, 44,000+ people stand to lose healthcare coverage between the Republican cuts to Medi-Cal and their plot to gut the Affordable Care Act. I will never support legislation that robs my constituents of healthcare and raises the costs for everyone else. This Republican healthcare crisis is out of control.

We’re on day two of a Republican shutdown and our healthcare providers are already feeling the effects. Yesterday, I visited community health centers across the district to discuss the Republican healthcare crisis and its impacts on patient costs. https://t.co/GMFLIpBsXK

Unless Republicans pass a bill to protect healthcare, premiums will DOUBLE. 

If the Affordable Care Act tax credits expire, people in our community will see their premiums rise more than $13,000. 

People can’t afford this. https://t.co/JDjXdEj9Hl

PPPSGV, like other @PPFA health centers, are continuing to see anyone who walks through their doors despite being barred from receiving Medi-Cal reimbursements after the passage of the Big Ugly Law. Patients can still get the high-quality healthcare they know and trust. I toured the Baldwin Park health center to thank the selfless providers who continue to provide lifesaving care to our community.

While Republicans rip away healthcare, our providers are continuing to serve the needs of our neighbors. I visited a community center in West Covina to discuss what we can do to support patients and providers during the Republican healthcare crisis. Thank you to our tireless healthcare professionals who continue to keep our community safe and healthy.
